claims.content: The Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness information, including track and reference point data, from the Surveillance NPG to support its platform mission.

goal.raw_text: The Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness information, including track and reference point data, from the Surveillance NPG to support its platform mission.

claims.content: Non-C2 JU
The Non-C2 JU is participating in the Link 16 network and is configured to monitor the Surveillance Network Participation Group (NPG).
The Non-C2 JU is prohibited from transmitting on the Surveillance NPG.
Remote surveillance track and point data are available in the J3 series messages for the Non-C2 JU to receive.
Remote surveillance track and reference point data becomes available on the Surveillance Network Participation Group (NPG) for the Non-C2 JU to receive.

trigger.raw_text: Remote surveillance track and reference point data becomes available on the Surveillance Network Participation Group (NPG) for the Non-C2 JU to receive.

claims.content: The Non-C2 JU monitors the Surveillance Network Participation Group (NPG).
The Non-C2 JU receives remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages (e.g., J3.0, J3.1, J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, J3.5, J3.6, J3.7).
The Non-C2 JU uses the received situational awareness and early warning information to support its platform mission.
If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority.
Any track or non-C2 IU with an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1 shall not be filtered; similarly, a J3.1 message shall not be filtered.
Units receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 2) Change Data Order message containing an ID of Pending shall not accept that order.
Receiving JUs which do not implement the changed Environment/Category and have R² on the track must cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
The Non-C2 JU has received remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages.
The Non-C2 JU possesses situational awareness and early warning information necessary to support its platform mission.
